desc: Write the complete Python solution: lazy segment tree over [1, 5e5] with min/max of h(x)=x+add(x), supporting range_add, find_first_geq (descend via node max), find_last_geq (descend via node min), and point query; process N contests then Q queries with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer).
Verify correctness mentally on Sample 1 (X=3→6, X=2→6, X=5→8) and check edge cases: empty intervals (a>b), boundaries a=1 / b=V, recursion depth, and 1-indexed consistency.
